notes.heading: about
body: i grew up in india and now i build things in new york.
this page is a copy of the softboard that hung in my room back home. same notes, same pins, printed instead of pinned.
i like tinkering, ideas in the shower i will never work on, and lazing in the sun with a glass of orange juice.
it is nice to meet you.
